name: EOCA Project Funding
summary: Annual funding round for non-profit organisations running projects that conserve, restore or reconnect habitats important for biodiversity in wild landscapes, with benefits for local communities. Shortlisted projects are chosen by public and member votes.
reporting: interim report and financial statement halfway through, final report and financial statement at project completion, plus progress updates as requested

steps: Public and members vote, if shortlisted

eligibility.rule: Protect a threatened species or habitat
Has no EOCA-funded project still running without an accepted final report
Implement a project lasting no more than two years
Have a website or active social media account
Use rights-based approaches to decision making
Not an urban, purely social, research, education or building project

status.quote: Our next funding round will be March 2027.

administered_by.quote: EOCA has a TWO stage application process. The 1st short stage application form will be available on the 'Apply for funding' page during the month of March.

applicant_types.quote: Non-profit organisations can apply to EOCA for funding each Spring.

access.quote: Non-profit organisations can apply to EOCA for funding each Spring.

window.quote: we are moving back to one funding round per year.

amount.quote: EOCA will fund a MAXIMUM of €30 000 per project.

co_finance_required.quote: The total project budget may be higher if there are other sources of funding.

reporting.quote: Yes, this is a requirement of all projects EOCA supports.

effort.quote: The 1st stage is a short application form.
If this application is successful, we will email you the 2nd stage, full application form to complete.
These projects then receive an in-depth review by our panel of scientific advisers, resulting in the final project shortlist.
The projects to successfully win funding will be chosen from the shortlist via a public vote and/or an EOCA’s members vote.

eligibility.quote: protect a threatened species or habitat;
If your project is being funded by EOCA, you can only reapply once this has finished and the final report has been accepted.
of up to two years in duration
Organisations are required to have an online presence, which can be either a website or active social media account (s), to be considered for funding by EOCA.
use rights-based approaches to decision making.
Projects in urban areas. 100% community or social projects. 100% research / PhDs / MSCs / expeditions / conference attendance. 100% education projects. Building projects.

after_award.quote: only after an interim report and financial statement has been submitted and accepted, and the final 20% after project completion and acceptance of the final report and financial statement.
